about: Where a spec's logo lands on the program's page, which is decided by how wide the page is rather than by the spec. A logo beside the page is a reservation taken before anything is laid out — the page is narrowed by the art's width and a two-column gutter — so these vectors pin the wrapped page as well as the art, and a implementation that placed the art without narrowing the page would fail them on the text rather than on the picture. Rendered at 80 columns like the rest of the corpus.

vectors.doc: Six columns of art and two of gutter leave the page 72, and the art starts at 74. The description wraps to 72 rather than to 80, which is the reservation showing: an implementation that placed the art on a page laid out at the full width would fail this on the text. The blank line that separates the description from the synopsis is where the last line of art sits.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
about "An example whose description is long enough to show that the page was narrowed before the art was placed beside it"
logo "  /\\\n /  \\\n/____\\"
flag "--force" help="Do it anyway"

short_help: An example whose description is long enough to show that the page was       /\
narrowed before the art was placed beside it                               /  \
long_help: An example whose description is long enough to show that the page was       /\
narrowed before the art was placed beside it                               /  \

vectors.doc: Art 34 columns wide would leave the page 44, under the fifty a page keeps for itself, so the page keeps its full width and the art goes above it as a banner.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
about "An example"
logo "----------------------------------\n|   a very wide logo indeed      |\n----------------------------------"
flag "--force" help="Do it anyway"

vectors.doc: Ninety columns of art on an eighty-column page is not a logo once it has wrapped, so the page renders as though the spec declared none.

Art that is nothing but whitespace is no logo, and reserves nothing. The first line runs to column eighty: a page that had reserved the gutter for zero columns of art would have wrapped it at seventy-eight and moved the last word down.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
about "An example whose first description line ends exactly at column eighty here so a narrowed page is visible"
logo "   "
flag "--force" help="Do it anyway"

short_help: An example whose first description line ends exactly at column eighty here so a
long_help: An example whose first description line ends exactly at column eighty here so a

vectors.doc: Art may carry its own colour, for a logo that wants more of it than one `style` can name. A plain page loses those escapes as it loses any other authored escape, and the art is measured by what it prints either way — two columns here, not the eleven the bytes would count.
vectors.spec:
name "ex"
bin "ex"
about "An example"
logo "\u{1b}[31mab\u{1b}[0m\n\u{1b}[32mcd\u{1b}[0m"
flag "--force" help="Do it anyway"
